local companies = tool('list_companies', {})
-- build domain -> company name map
local by_domain = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  if c.domain then by_domain[string.lower(c.domain)] = c.name end
end

local function is_e164(p)
  return p ~= nil and string.match(p, '^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') ~= nil
end

local function to_e164(p)
  local digits = string.gsub(p, '%D', '')
  if #digits == 11 and string.sub(digits, 1, 1) == '1' then
    digits = string.sub(digits, 2)
  end
  if #digits == 10 then
    return '+1' .. digits
  end
  return nil -- can't fix
end

local contacts, page = {}, 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  for _, c in ipairs(r.items) do contacts[#contacts + 1] = c end
  page = page + 1
until page > (r.total_pages or 1)

local updates, skipped = {}, {}
for _, c in ipairs(contacts) do
  local upd = {}
  if c.phone and c.phone ~= '' and not is_e164(c.phone) then
    local fixed = to_e164(c.phone)
    if fixed then upd.phone = fixed else skipped[#skipped + 1] = { id = c.id, phone = c.phone } end
  end
  if (c.company == nil or c.company == '') and c.email then
    local dom = string.lower(string.match(c.email, '@(.+)$') or '')
    local name = by_domain[dom]
    if name then upd.company = name end
  end
  if upd.phone or upd.company then
    upd.id = c.id
    updates[#updates + 1] = upd
  end
end

local phones_fixed, companies_filled = 0, 0
local results = {}
for _, u in ipairs(updates) do
  local r = tool('update_contact', u)
  if u.phone then phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1 end
  if u.company then companies_filled = companies_filled + 1 end
  results[#results + 1] = r
end

return {
  total_contacts = #contacts,
  phones_fixed = phones_fixed,
  companies_filled = companies_filled,
  skipped = skipped,
  updated = results,
}
